summary.text: Aileen Hampton is the Republican candidate for Utah House of Representatives District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces Democratic incumbent Sahara Hayes.
A government relations professional and Census Bureau field representative, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is offering voters a moderate choice.

paragraphs.text: Aileen Hampton earned a high school diploma from North Park Secondary School and a bachelor's degree from McMaster University in 1993, and her career experience includes working in government relations.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born in Provo, grew up outside Toronto and returned to Utah 30 years ago to work as a molecular biology lab technician at the University of Utah.

She said she has lived in South Salt Lake for 20 years, is a single mother of four sons, currently works as a Census Bureau field representative and served as secretary of her sons' school community council.
Hampton said her key messages include fiscal responsibility, targeting fraud in Medicaid and Medicare, and supporting lower-income residents and seniors.
